'''September 1999 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia on 26 September 1999. [[Michael Josem]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d61">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-03-melbourne-victoria-26-9-99d61/ melbourne-victoria-26-9-99], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 3 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-03-melbourne-victoria-26-9-99d61/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 September 1999
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Josem]]
